en: Colorized vintage street view of an urban square with a tall column bearing a clock on top in the foreground. Around the square stand multi‑story buildings with enclosed glass balconies typical of northern Spain. One prominent corner building has a sign on the roof reading "PALACE HOTEL" and street‑level awnings. Tram tracks cross the paved square and a few pedestrians walk in the middle distance. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed caption text identifying the scene as a street junction in La Coruña.
